description: BeSim is a MATLAB toolbox for building-energy control research. It connects Modelica simulations and linear white-box representations with controllers, including model-predictive control and state estimation. The repository documents a reusable toolbox and closed-loop workflows. Its listed MATLAB 2017a/2017b environment is historical, so compatibility with current dependencies requires testing. Published by drgona (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: GPL-3.0 (repository licence label). The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
